entities.name: cell senescence and SASP in nucleus pulposus cells

relationships.subject: muscone
relationships.evidence_quote: in vitro validation showed that the expression of p53 was obviously reduced after muscone treatment compared with after IL-1β treatment alone (P < 0.01)

relationships.subject: p53
relationships.object: cell senescence and SASP in nucleus pulposus cells
relationships.evidence_quote: p53 activation markedly reversed the downregulation of SASP markers MMP3, MMP13, IL-6 and IL-8 (P < 0.01), and cell senescence markers p16INK4A and p21CIP (P < 0.05)caused by muscone in IL-1β-treated NP cells

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: increases cell apoptosis and the protein/mRNA expression of ADAMTS4, MMP1, MMP3 and MMP13

relationships.subject: muscone
relationships.object: cell senescence and SASP in nucleus pulposus cells
relationships.evidence_quote: muscone protects against the degeneration of nucleus pulposus cells by inhibiting p53 signaling

key_findings: Muscone reduces IL-1β-induced ECM catabolism, apoptosis, senescence and SASP in NP cells by inhibiting p53; p53 agonist SCH529074 reverses this in vitro and in a mouse puncture IDD model.
